design_detail: annual net wealth tax from EUR 700,000 (1% to 4% in five bands); Sabor conclusion asking the Government for a bill
quote_original: Radnička fronta predlaže da se oporezuju najbogatiji - uvođenjem poreza na neto bogatstvo.
quote_en: Radnička fronta proposes taxing the richest by introducing a net wealth tax.
grading_note: Formal act: on 15 September 2023 the party presented and submitted a Prijedlog zaključka in the Sabor asking the Government to draft a net wealth tax law, with rates and threshold. Outcome not checked.

design_detail: EUR 700,000 threshold; 1% rising to 4% above EUR 100 million; liability by citizenship and an exit tax
quote_original: Predlažemo porez na neto bogatstvo koji bi oporezivao ukupnu imovinu 1% najbogatijih – nekretnine, štednju u bankama, (su)vlasništvo u tvrtkama.
quote_en: We propose a net wealth tax that would tax the total assets of the richest 1% - real estate, bank savings, ownership in companies.
grading_note: Point of the 2024 election programme with the full rate schedule.

design_detail: net wealth tax from EUR 700,000, hitting the richest 1% of households
quote_original: Konkretno smo dali nekoliko tih stopa, koje kreću od 700.000 eura, što je 10 puta više od prosječne imovine koju ima svaki hrvatski građanin.
quote_en: We gave several rates, starting at EUR 700,000, which is ten times the average assets of a Croatian citizen.
source_title: VIDEO Peović: Nemoguće da Martina Dalić vrijedi 40 puta više od radnice u pogonu
grading_note: Interview in the 2024 campaign describing the party's net wealth tax schedule and the 1% of households it would hit.

design_detail: net wealth tax on the assets of the richest 1% of households
quote_original: To je porez koji bi zahvatio imovinu 1 posto najbogatijih kućanstva, imovinu onih koji ne plaćaju nikakav porez na silne nekretnine i milijune na štednji u bankama
quote_en: It is a tax that would capture the assets of the richest 1 percent of households, who pay no tax on vast real estate and millions in bank savings.
grading_note: Direct quote at the presentation of the party programme, naming the net wealth tax and who it would hit.

design_detail: higher taxes on rents and wealth, lower on labour; no rate or base
quote_original: manje tereta na rad uz veće poreze na rente i bogatstvo
quote_en: less burden on labour with higher taxes on rents and wealth
grading_note: Economic model adopted at the 10th convention: wealth is to be taxed more, but no wealth-tax design is named and "rente i bogatstvo" could also mean property or capital income.

design_detail: Sabor conclusion asking the Government to introduce a net wealth tax; never debated before the 10th Sabor was dissolved
quote_original: Katarina Peović  (RF) da uvede porez na neto bogatstvo
quote_en: Katarina Peović (RF) [asks the Government] to introduce a net wealth tax
source_title: Raspuštanje Sabora: ostaje neraspravljeno oko 180 točaka
grading_note: Nacional's list of undebated opposition conclusions names Peović as the proposer of the net wealth tax conclusion (submitted 15 September 2023, per RF); date is the submission.

design_detail: threshold EUR 700,000; marginal rates 1% to 4% above EUR 100 million
quote_original: Najniža granica za oporezivanje na neto bogatstvo bi bila 700.000 eura i marginalne stope bile bi od 1 do 4 posto iznad 100 milijuna eura.
quote_en: The lowest threshold for net wealth taxation would be EUR 700,000 and marginal rates would run from 1 to 4 percent above EUR 100 million.
source_title: Peović: Novi porez ne bi obuhvatio nekoga tko je naslijedio klet, nego Željku Markić
grading_note: Her own words presenting the proposal with threshold and rates.

design_detail: wants the new real-estate tax to be conceived as a wealth tax
quote_original: Moja glavna zamjerka je što bi porez trebao biti koncipiran kao porez na imovinu, porez na bogatstvo
quote_en: My main objection is that the tax should be conceived as a property tax, a wealth tax.
source_title: Ekonomist tumači zašto bi novi porezni paket mogao ulijevati nadu, ali i zašto je skeptičan
grading_note: Says the 2024 real-estate tax should be a wealth tax; "imovina" can also mean property, no design given, so B.
